purpose: a quantified initial clear-top description receives W0 and does not hold as a law after stacking; a standing stored-state assertion is unsupported
text: There is a robot hand. Blocks a, b and c are on the table. Nothing is on any block. The hand is empty.

must_have.note: the quantifier is retained; the fluent is at W0

queries.text: After the hand takes c, puts c on a and takes b, can the hand put b on a?

expect.evidence: at W0+2 the strict effect gives -clear_top(a); the description S3 holds at W0 only, so no clause re-establishes clear_top(a) at W0+3. The block branch fails; the surface branch is neither established nor refuted for a block (c05b), and no necessity clause mentions clearance, so there is no negative proof: Unknown. Historical evidence (2026-09-09, the experimental library of elogs/action_axioms_2026_09_05 in the old layout): under the law reading (c1p_law.out.json) GK returned answers [] and a confidence-1 item in rejected_answers; under the description reading (c1p_description.out.json) the candidate was undercut to 0.0. Neither is an accepted Yes; the law reading is the defect this fixture pins because its rejected item shows the illegal step derivable.

alternative.when: GK returns an eligible candidate (above the 0.10 cutoff, in answers); the replay then rejects it at the second placement on a, as K1

expect.evidence: one block on a block. Saved evidence c1_description.out.json (2026-09-09): five candidates, every one undercut to 0.0, below the cutoff, so none is eligible and the outcome is not_found. A backend that returns an eligible candidate makes the outcome candidate_not_validated with K1's verdict; plan_found is forbidden either way.

explain: Fable addenda point 1 with Astra's correction: the description keeps its quantifier and receives W0; nothing about the head predicate decides that. The variant is the same formula under the explicit state_law wrapper, which the contract declares unsupported for stored physical state. Q1's expected answer is Unknown with Yes and No both forbidden; the reason Unknown is not No is in c05b. Q2 pins not_found from the saved undercut evidence and names candidate_not_validated as the outcome on a backend that returns an eligible candidate.
